source.knownIngressDefect: The requested transparent background was returned as a baked light checkerboard. The deterministic light-key stage removes it; raw bytes are retained unchanged.

preparation.operation: resize to 1024 x 1024, key and decontaminate the near-neutral baked matte, remove boundary-connected cross-cell fragments, normalize each cell into a 220 x 208 safe envelope, recenter it, and emit a palette PNG with alpha

review.notes: All sixteen cells have distinct readable Gothic ground stories, coherent isometric perspective, consistent material rendering, and generous cell padding. Runtime promotion remains conditional on atlas validation and composed-screen review.
